DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY &
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014, INDIA
Advertisement for the appointment of Research associate (RA)
Applications are invited for one position of Research associate (RA) in the DST-
Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) sponsored research project
entitled “Development of NIR Emitting Peptide Conjugated Metallic
Nanoclusters for Effective Photothermal Therapy” sanctioned to the
undersigned in collaboration with IIT Hyderabad. Interested candidates may
submit their application (on plain paper) along with detailed resume (with
email & contact no.), attested copies of certificates and work experience to the
undersigned (email or hard copy) latest by 24.01.2024 (Wednesday). The
interview date will be intimated later.
Essential Qualifications:
M.Sc./M.S./M.Pharm/M.Tech with Ph.D. degree (or Ph.D. thesis submitted) in
the field of Chemistry/Organic Chemistry/Medicinal Chemistry/Pharmaceutical
Chemistry/Materials/Nanotechnology/allied branches
Desirable: Prior knowledge/experience of chemical synthesis of
nanoconjugates and biomolecules shall be preferable.
Salary: The selected candidate will be paid salary + HRA as per DST-SERB rules.
Duration: Initial appointment for one year, extendable up to three years based
on performance. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project
Note: No TA / DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
Dr. Rohit Kumar Sharma
(Principal Investigator)
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University,
Sector-14 Chandigarh-160014
Email:rohitksg@pu.ac.in
